article_context: Cover image for an article presenting Dream Island as a place of atmosphere, architecture, emotions and photo opportunities beyond rides; the animation should make its welcoming entrance feel lively and inviting.
image_reading: Three bright orange mascot characters stand smiling in front of the castle-like Dream Island entrance, with the central character already raising one hand.
A fountain sprays at the left, small flags atop the towers can move in the breeze, and the group is framed symmetrically against the facade.

models.positive_prompt: The three mascot characters make one warm, unhurried welcoming wave toward the viewer while the fountain continues to spray and the tower flags flutter lightly. Keep a fixed camera. By the final frame, their raised hands settle in a clear friendly greeting pose.
models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the mascots carry out a single coordinated greeting: the visible raised arms move outward and gently wave once, with the other characters joining through simple arm motion. The fountain and flags provide light continuous secondary motion. Fixed framing keeps the castle entrance and all three mascots visible; their hands settle raised in a readable welcome near the end.

models.positive_prompt: The mascots give a gradual collective welcome wave toward the viewer; fountain water sparkles and the small flags flutter. A subtle forward camera move centers the smiling group. End with all three holding an open, welcoming pose.
models.scene_plan: For the five-second shot, use a slow, modest push toward the three mascots as their greeting develops from the existing pose into one calm collective wave. The focal target is the central mascot and the open gestures of the group. Fountain spray and flags move naturally throughout; the approach resolves with the whole group visibly posed in welcome.

models.positive_prompt: A gentle camera push toward the mascot trio as they complete one cheerful welcome wave to the viewer. The fountain sprays steadily and the flags flutter softly. In the final frame, the group holds a bright open greeting pose.
models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, the central mascot leads one simple friendly wave and the adjacent mascots smoothly join it, creating a single welcoming action. A concise slow push-in emphasizes the trio without losing the entrance behind them. Keep the fountain and flags subtly active, ending as the characters hold their raised open-handed greeting.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The park welcomes visitors with a playful, memorable atmosphere and photo-worthy entrance.
structured_intent.primary_action: The three mascot characters perform one collective friendly greeting wave toward the viewer.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The entrance remains a joyful, welcoming invitation to visit Dream Island.
structured_intent.terminal_state: All three mascots are visibly holding an open, friendly greeting pose toward the viewer.
